cfa_lead: The architecture you want, written as a contract. JGates never infers it: it checks what is in the file.
cfa_governed_reason: Governed mode: the rules are fixed by the policy {policy} and do not change here.
cfa_missing: There is no {file} yet. Create the rules: JGates proposes the layers from the project's folders and you confirm.
cfa_map_lead: Arrows show allowed dependencies between neighbouring layers; the crossed arrow marks a pair that an enabled rule forbids.
cfa_rule_boundary: The component {component} can only depend on {allowed}.
cfa_rule_fan: Fan-in and fan-out limit in {layer}: in {fanIn}, out {fanOut}.
cfa_cov_off: No architecture adapter is enabled. Available: {tools}.
cfa_cov_none: No adapter in the project checks architecture: the rule will not be checked.
cfa_unresolved_none: No validation with architecture has run yet, so there is no graph to show.
cfa_unresolved_run: From the last run with architecture: {run}.
cfa_generated_lead: Generated from the rules in the last run, read-only. To change it, edit architecture.yml.
cfa_generated_none: No native configuration has been generated yet.
cfa_ed_lead_edit: Changes only what you alter here. The comments and the rest of {file} stay as they are.
cfa_ed_lead_new: The file {file} is created after the review. The layers come from the project's folders and nothing is written before you confirm.
cfa_ed_layers_help: A layer is a group of folders with the same role. The ones marked as proposed came from the project's folders.
cfa_ed_layers_none: No project folder looks like a known layer. Create a layer below and choose its folders.
cfa_ed_modules_only: This layer is defined by modules in the file and stays as it is.
cfa_ed_paths_needed: Choose at least one folder for this layer.
cfa_ed_rules_help: Each rule forbids a layer from importing others. The proposals follow the rule that the inside does not depend on the outside.
cfa_ed_rules_none: There are no rules yet. With two layers ticked you can create one.
cfa_ed_rule_incomplete: Choose a ticked layer and at least one other forbidden layer.
cfa_ed_kept: {count, plural, one {# more rule of another kind stays in the file, unchanged.} other {# more rules of other kinds stay in the file, unchanged.}}
cfa_ed_review_help: These are the lines that change in {file}.
cfa_keys_title: Every key of the rules and layers
cfa_keys_lead: Every key of {file}, including those written by hand, with its control and saved one at a time.
